summary: The pre-push hook signs the light checks before the push goes in more cases: an agent push waits up to 300 s (was 120 s), typescript-client runs first, ST_SKIP_EVIDENCE=1 means 'do not wait' (the same signing runs in the background) instead of skipping it, a tree that edits a lane is reported as not signed rather than as a failed check, one signing run per tree, and every push of the checked-out head leaves a receipt line of what the hook did.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

schema.detail: No stored or wire format changes; receipts.jsonl is a new local, append-only file under the hook's existing state directory.

rules.detail: What counts as evidence is unchanged; only when the hook signs and what it says.

compatibility.detail: ST_SKIP_EVIDENCE=1 no longer skips signing: the push still goes at once and the checks are signed in the background. st-test runs typescript-client before genie-freshness, and exits 4 (new) when nothing failed but a check was not signed because the tree edits that check's lane; it no longer runs that check's command. The hook, st-test and the wrapper all come from origin/main, so they change together.

manual.detail: None: the installed stub runs the base's hook, so every checkout picks this up once it is on main.

recovery.detail: Revert the pull request; ST_EVIDENCE_AGENT_LIMIT=120 restores the old wait meanwhile.
